A '''chronicle of galactic history''' was compiled by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and released in [[36 ABY]] in the wake of the [[Dark Nest Crisis]]. The chronicle itself was a second edition of an [[The Essential Chronology|earlier chronicle]], released in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]. The "Introduction to Students of History" that opened the work was written by [[archivist emeritus]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]. It was later quoted by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]] in "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]."
